description: Look up an Optimism transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use op_receipt, for emitted events op_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x721f3e9a996da49e2a8929bd2dd42e0f51344c11d7ca7bc3328fda349cdfae89. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: op_tx
title: Optimism transaction
